## Visualization of gene expression in modules

The maintained entry point is `run_gene_visualization()`. Advanced users should
call it directly from R code with explicit arguments:

```{r}
visualization_result <- run_gene_visualization(
  session_dir = session_dir,
  network_type = network_type,
  modules = modules,
  plot_type = "module_trajectories",
  group_column = group_column,
  annotation_columns = annotation_columns
)
```

The remaining chunks preserve the earlier low-level implementation for
provenance only. Load the standardized artifacts supplied by the caller:

```{r}
prepared <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
load(file.path(session_dir, "out", "1_prepared_data.RData"), envir = prepared)
data <- prepared$data
network_result <- readRDS(file.path(session_dir, "out", "3_networks.rds"))
net <- network_result$network
net_km <- network_result$network_kmeans
```

Load the normalized counts generated during data preparation

```{r}
if (is.null(data$normalized_counts)) {
  stop(
    "The prepared-data artifact does not contain normalized counts. ",
    "Re-run Stage 1 with the updated normalization step."
  )
}

norm_counts <- data$normalized_counts

if (!setequal(colnames(norm_counts), rownames(data$metadata))) {
  stop("Normalized counts and metadata contain different sample identifiers.")
}

# Keep metadata in exactly the same sample order as the normalized counts.
data$metadata <- data$metadata[colnames(norm_counts), , drop = FALSE]
```

heatmap modules eigenvalues

```{r}
pheatmap(t(net$MEs), annotation_col = data$metadata[-2], cluster_cols = F)
```

```{r}
data$metadata <- mutate(data$metadata, sample = paste0(stage, "_", rep))

selected_genes <- names(net_km$colors[net_km$colors == "yellow"])

df <- cbind(data$metadata, t(norm_counts))
df_long <- df %>%
  select(sample, stage, all_of(selected_genes)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = selected_genes,
               names_to = "Gene", 
    values_to = "Value")

matplot(x= sample, y=df[,selected_genes], type = "l")

ggplot(data = df_long, aes(x = sample, y = Value)) +
  geom_line()
  
```

```{r}
module_df <- as.data.frame(net_km$colors)
colnames(module_df) <- "color"
module_df$gene_id <- rownames(module_df)

submod = module_df %>% subset(color %in% c( "yellow", "turquoise", "blue", "brown", "green", "red"))

subexpr = norm_counts[rownames(submod),]

submod_df = data.frame(subexpr) %>%
   mutate(
     gene_id = row.names(.)
   ) %>%
   pivot_longer(-gene_id) %>%
   mutate(
     module = module_df[gene_id,]$color
   )

# Define your desired order
desired_order <- rownames(data$metadata)

# Convert name to a factor with specified order
submod_df$name <- factor(submod_df$name, levels = desired_order)


ggplot(submod_df, aes(x = name, y = value, group = gene_id)) +
   geom_line(aes(color = module)) +scale_color_identity()+
   theme_bw() +
   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
   facet_grid(rows = vars(module), scales = "free_y") +
   labs(x = "stage", y = "normalized expression")
```
